changes.comment: api-client-tiger: Removed the auth-json-api module from client generation; its endpoints live in metadata-json-api. `ActionsApiProcessInvitationRequest` and `Invitation` now come from metadata-json-api and `ActionsApi_ProcessInvitation` is exported from `endpoints/actions`. Removed `tigerAuthActionsClientFactory`, `AuthActionsApiInterface`, `ITigerClient.authActions`, the `endpoints/authActions` entry point and the unprefixed `Configuration`/`ConfigurationParameters` exports (use the module-prefixed ones, e.g. `MetadataConfiguration`).
